svg.text: Normalized Relational Mapping (3NF) • Row-of-Cells Style with Orthogonal Foreign Key Constraints
Standard Relational Mapping Notation (23 Tables, 3NF Certified)
Composite Primary Key & Foreign Key (both solid and dashed underlines)
Underline below table spanning key cells = Composite Primary Key
UQ badge = Candidate Key / UNIQUE constraint (e.g., Student.Email)
Orthogonal Arrow: Foreign Key column -> referenced table Primary Key cell
Derived / Non-persisted attributes (TotalPoints, Level, TeamSize) are computed via SQL / EF Core, not stored
Designed for Microsoft SQL Server & Entity Framework Core (ASP.NET Core Web API / JWT Auth)
